purpose: Reduce avoidable one-feed performance loss while preserving the low-variance family-specialist architecture. Train each missing-feed fusion stack on hard NEW-SEP labels plus a fixed soft target from the fit-only full three-expert stack.
prior_results_disclosed: direct remaining-sensor specialist v2 rejected on development

architecture.FULL: unchanged PositiveEvidenceStack on SOLAR+XRS+PROTON cross-fitted evidence
architecture.teacher: fit-only full PositiveEvidenceStack probability on the same cross-fitted OOF evidence rows

roles.fit: family experts, full teacher, and distilled student fusion fitting only
roles.threshold: MAX_TSS and POD80_MIN_FAR threshold selection only

primary_comparison: V3 distilled missing-feed stack versus V1 scalar missing-feed stack on identical score rows; V2 is retained as a negative development result but is not a candidate.
keep_v3_for_future_untouched_evaluation_: NO_XRS and NO_PROTON each have MAX_TSS no lower than V1 by more than 0.02
NO_XRS and NO_PROTON each have Brier no worse than V1 by more than 0.005
NO_XRS and NO_PROTON each have ECE no worse than V1 by more than 0.01
NO_XRS and NO_PROTON each have 5-percent review enrichment no lower than V1 by more than 1.0x
all probabilities are finite and no missing family is used at runtime
claim_boundary: V3 can only become the frozen candidate for untouched evaluation. NORMAL/VALID trust still requires independent evidence through the separate availability trust gate.
